// diagnostic

E3515

Nothing in this build makes `{path}`, which {user} uses

What

Nothing in this build makes `{path}`, which {user} uses

Why

A file under `.jet/generated/` is what this build's producers make, so one that none of them makes is stale or was never made, and nothing checks it

Fix

Restore the `b.generate`, `meta.add` or step output that made `{path}`, or remove it from {user}

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3515: tests/ui/meta_ladder_missing_producer.stderr.

Error [jet.MissingProducer]: Nothing in this build makes `.jet/generated/meta_ladder_missing_producer/count.jet`, which the target `app` uses
  --> tests/ui/meta_ladder_missing_producer.jet:6:12
    |
  6 |     app: b.add_executable("app", ["meta_ladder_missing_producer.jet", ".jet/generated/meta_ladder_missing_producer/count.jet"], [])
    |            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A file under `.jet/generated/` is what this build's producers make, so one that none of them makes is stale or was never made, and nothing checks it
 Fix: Restore the `b.generate`, `meta.add` or step output that made `.jet/generated/meta_ladder_missing_producer/count.jet`, or remove it from the target `app`
